title: Funnel chart
description: Stages of a process that lose volume along the way (sign-ups, sales pipeline, checkout), with the conversion rate from each stage to the next. Hover or use the arrow keys to highlight a stage; click a legend item to hide it.

props.name: data
props.description: Stages: a name, a value and an optional color

props.name: sort
props.description: Order of the stages

props.name: gap
props.description: Vertical gap between the stages, in pixels

props.name: conversion
props.description: Shows the conversion rate from the previous stage

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of the stages: trapezoids that narrow to the next stage, or centered bars

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D, above the shapes

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage, series, node, bar, row or level

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, number and percent formats, calendar dates); built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French (English otherwise)

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap or sunburst nodes / sankey nodes / radial bars / bullet rows / calendar levels, by index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only call `onToggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back. Leave undefined to let the legend hide / show entries by itself.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations (skipped when the user prefers reduced motion)

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: renderTooltip
props.description: React content of the tooltip (replaces the default content)

events.name: onToggle
events.description: Called when a legend item is clicked (or the instance's `toggle()` is called), with the toggled index and every hidden index after the toggle

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changes

events.name: onClick
events.description: Called when a mark is clicked, tapped or activated with Enter

examples.title: Bars and sorting
examples.description: shape="bar" draws centered bars for values that are not a sequence; sort orders them (animated) and conversion={false} hides the rates.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Trapezoids narrow to the next stage and show the conversion rate; renderTooltip adds the share of visitors and the drop-off in React.

examples.title: Marketing funnel by channel
examples.description: A Select filters the funnel to one acquisition channel and the stages animate to the new counts. renderTooltip adds the conversion from the previous stage and the cost per result, computed from the channel's spend; the line below gives the customer acquisition cost.

examples.title: Comparing segments
examples.description: The same funnel split by device, side by side with the same stages and one color per segment, to see where mobile users drop out.

examples.title: E-commerce checkout
examples.description: A shop's checkout funnel next to a Table of the drop-off between stages; the stage that loses the most visitors is highlighted in red in both.

examples.title: Live flash sale
examples.description: A one-hour sale replayed in 30 ticks (setInterval, cleared on pause, at the end and on unmount): new visitors arrive and move down the stages with a seeded random generator. The status line follows the clock, and only the end of the sale is announced.

examples.title: Hiring pipeline
examples.description: Candidates of one role from application to hire as bars with one color per stage; the tooltip adds the typical time spent in the stage and a click selects it.

examples.title: B2B sales pipeline
examples.description: Stages sized by the amount of their open deals, with conversion={false} because each stage holds different deals. onClick lists the deals of a stage next to the funnel, and renderTooltip shows their count and win probability.

examples.title: What-if conversion model
examples.description: The −1 / +1 buttons change the conversion rate of one checkout step and the funnel is recomputed from the visits; the summary compares the orders and the revenue with today's rates. Rates are kept in whole percent points so that Reset knows when nothing has changed.

basic.title: Basic

data.tapStage: Tap a stage to select it

conversion.title: Conversion funnel
conversion.description: Stages narrowing to the next one, each labelled with its conversion rate from the previous stage.

bars.title: Sorted bars
bars.description: Centered bars instead of trapezoids, with the stages sorted by value.

props.hideConversion: Hides the conversion rates from the previous stage
props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage, radar series or top-level treemap node by index
methods.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready; set it with the renderer engine option
